Former France coach Didier Deschamps has told Manchester United he is not interested becoming the club's manager, with current boss Michael Carrick's future in doubt. (Mirror), external
There is still support among the Manchester United hierarchy for Carrick, with Sunday's game against Aston Villa seen as key. (Sky Sports), external
Tottenham retain the right to match a bid made for England striker Harry Kane, 33, as part of his new deal at Bayern Munich. (Telegraph - subscription required), external
Arsenal and Manchester United are tracking Bournemouth midfielder Marcus Tavernier, 27. (Teamtalk), external
Arsenal are among the European clubs interested in Club Brugge striker and Germany Under-21s international Nicolo Tresoldi, 22. (Tuttomercato - in Italian), external
Manchester United, Chelsea and Liverpool are tracking Eintracht Frankfurt and Germany defender Nnamdi Collins, 22. (Fussball News - in German), external
Liverpool are poised to step up their interest in English Fenerbahce full-back Archie Brown, 24. (Teamtalk), external
Liverpool goalkeeper Alisson, 34, is attracting interest from Flamengo in his native Brazil. (Sport Witness), external
Newcastle United have set their sights on signing England striker Ivan Toney, 30, from Saudi Arabian club Al-Ahli in January. (Football Insider), external
Eintracht Frankfurt are hopeful of re-signing Nottingham Forest's French forward Arnaud Kalimuendo, 24. (L'Equipe - in French), external
Chelsea's English winger Jamie Gittens, 22, is one of the options Roma are considering in order to strengthen their squad in January. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian), external
AC Milan are in talks with France midfielder Adrien Rabiot, 31, about extending his contract. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian), external
